text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having claimed a magnificent first-place 
finish in front of her parents and 
Trainer, Eishin Flash bowed with a heart 
full of deep emotion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her parents rejoiced greatly at her 
victory, showing their deep respect with 
the words, "We are so proud of you."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this, her goal was achieved. Sharing 
her burning spirit as she geared up for 
her final "Arima Kinen"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Holding onto the hope that she will 
continue running, the Trainer begins 
working on the post-Arima Kinen schedule.
